blocks.title: Comprehensive project planning
blocks.text: Jame (comprehensive) project planning ka matlab shuru karne se pehle project ki tamam tafseelat par sochna hai: samajhna ke kya karna hai, kaun karega aur kaise karega.

Duniya ki kuch sab se bari software companies arbon dollar ki hain. Maslan 2023 tak Microsoft ki market capitalization 2 trillion dollar se zyada thi, jo aaj ke digital daur mein software development ki maashi ahmiyat dikhata hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Jame project planning ka aham pehlu kya hai (MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: Project ka daira (scope) aur kaam samajhna, option (a). Kitab ki answer key (c), 'bari development team rakhna', deti hai jo text se nahi nikalta.

items: Jame planning: shuru se pehle tay karna ke kya karna hai, kaun karega aur kaise.
